ai_overview.visible_text:
The Experiment Beauty Super Saturated Hydrating Barrier Serum ($28) is a thick, blue, gel-like serum powered by a high concentration of 30% glycerin and polyglutamic acid.
Amazon.ae
+1
Texture and the "Sticky" Feel
Tacky finish: Because it contains 30% glycerin, the serum has a distinct, gloopy, and slightly tacky or sticky texture right out of the bottle.
TikTok
·kellymengg
+1
Application tip: Opinions on Reddit's SkincareAddiction show mixed opinions, with some users finding the stickiness too heavy or prone to breakouts on acne-prone skin, while others love the dewy finish.
Reddit
·r/SkincareAddiction
Damp skin activation: The brand and reviewers recommend applying it to damp skin to help dilute the thick concentrate, turning it into a silky texture that grips well under makeup or sunscreen like a primer.
experimentbeauty.com
+1
Performance and Benefits
Deep hydration: Reviewers note that it offers an instant plumping and glowing effect that outperforms traditional hyaluronic acid serums.
TikTok
·james_s_welsh
+1
Barrier support: Formulated with prickly pear extract, bisabolol, and niacinamide, it is widely praised for helping skin tolerate harsh retinoids like tretinoin without flaking or irritation.
Reddit
·r/SkincareAddiction
+2
